customer_id.meaning: primary id of the patient profile (seed uuid or content hash)

name.meaning: patient's full legal name as printed on their identity document; not a verification credential

date_of_birth.meaning: patient's date of birth on the profile; the primary pharmacy identity credential and the basis of every age-based rule (age in whole years on the relevant date)

phone_number.meaning: mobile or home phone number registered on the profile

email.meaning: email address registered on the profile, lower case

home_zip.meaning: ZIP code of the patient's home address on the profile

street_address.meaning: street line of the patient's home address, used as the default delivery address

state_code.meaning: state of the patient's home address

preferred_store_id.meaning: the Kestrel store the patient chose as their home pharmacy (foreign key -> stores)

profile_opened_date.meaning: date the Kestrel patient profile was created

store_id.meaning: primary id of the Kestrel store record

store_number.meaning: public Kestrel store number printed on labels and receipts

store_name.meaning: public store name, e.g. the street or neighborhood name

state_code.meaning: state the store is licensed and located in; the state whose pharmacy law governs fills dispensed there

is_24_hour.meaning: whether the pharmacy counter is open 24 hours

has_drive_thru.meaning: whether the store has a pharmacy drive-thru window

has_pickup_locker.meaning: whether the store has a self-service prescription pickup locker

offers_immunizations.meaning: whether the store's pharmacists administer vaccines

prescriber_id.meaning: primary id of the prescriber record

name.meaning: prescriber's full name with credential, e.g. 'Dana Whitlock, MD'

epcs_enabled.meaning: whether the prescriber can send electronic prescriptions for controlled substances

prescription_id.meaning: primary id of the prescription record

customer_id.meaning: patient the prescription is written for (foreign key -> customers)

variant_name.meaning: handling class of the prescription, the official class name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the prescription (see the Prescriptions charter lifecycle)

rx_number.meaning: Kestrel prescription number printed on the label; the number patients quote

drug_strength.meaning: strength and dosage form as written, e.g. '40 mg tablet'

ndc.meaning: National Drug Code of the product selected for the prescription

days_supply.meaning: days supply per fill as written

refills_authorized.meaning: refills written by the prescriber, before any cap

refills_remaining.meaning: refills still available; identically the sum of the refills account deltas

owed_quantity.meaning: units still owed after a partial fill; identically the sum of the owed_units account deltas, 0 when nothing is owed

written_date.meaning: date the prescriber wrote the prescription; day 0 of the validity period

expiration_date.meaning: last date any fill may be dispensed: written_date plus the class's rx_validity_days

store_id.meaning: Kestrel store currently holding the prescription (foreign key -> stores)

prior_transfer_count.meaning: number of pharmacy-to-pharmacy transfers the prescription has had, including a transfer into Kestrel

transfer_destination.meaning: outside pharmacy name and phone number the prescription was transferred to, exactly as the patient stated them; empty unless transferred out

opened_date.meaning: date the prescription was entered at Kestrel

closed_date.meaning: date the prescription expired, was transferred out or discontinued; empty while received or active

fill_id.meaning: primary id of the fill-ledger row

prescription_id.meaning: prescription the row belongs to (foreign key -> rx_prescriptions)

event_type.meaning: fill-ledger event family, from the Prescriptions charter

event_date.meaning: date the event happened (dispensed, reversed, released, returned or cancelled)

fill_number.meaning: 0 for the original fill, 1 upward for refills in dispensing order; empty on non-fill rows

quantity_dispensed.meaning: units physically dispensed by this row

days_supply_dispensed.meaning: days supply the dispensed quantity lasts at the prescribed directions

fill_completeness.meaning: whether the fill carried the full prescribed quantity or was dispensed short

fill_reason.meaning: why a refill was dispensed; anything other than routine is an early refill

product_dispensed.meaning: whether a generic or the brand product was dispensed

payment_basis.meaning: how the patient's share of the fill was settled

patient_pay_usd.meaning: amount the patient paid for the fill, after insurance and any savings program; 0.00 for no-charge rows

refills_remaining_after.meaning: refills remaining on the prescription immediately after this fill

owed_units.meaning: units of owed balance booked by a partial-fill row or settled by a completion or cancellation row

refills_used.meaning: refills a refill consumed: its days supply divided by the prescription's days supply, rounded up

refills_restored.meaning: refills credited back by a return to stock: the refills_used of a returned refill, 0 for a returned original fill

source_fill_id.meaning: the single fill-ledger row this row acts on (the short fill, owed balance, fill returned, released, or found in error); empty on original fills and refills

source_fill_number.meaning: fill_number of the fill a return-to-stock row reverses

error_report_id.meaning: confirmed dispensing-error report an error return or remake is based on (foreign key -> rx_error_reports)

refund_usd.meaning: amount refunded to the patient on a dispensing-error return; positive

pickup_channel.meaning: how a fill was released to the patient

id_verified.meaning: whether government photo ID was checked at release

police_report_number.meaning: police report number the patient stated for a lost-or-stolen replacement; empty otherwise

ready_date.meaning: date the fill is (or was) ready for pickup; day 0 of the will-call hold

store_id.meaning: Kestrel store that dispensed the row (foreign key -> stores)

request_id.meaning: primary id of the prescriber-request row

prescription_id.meaning: prescription the request concerns (foreign key -> rx_prescriptions)

event_type.meaning: prescriber-request event family, from the Prescriptions charter

prescriber_id.meaning: prescriber the request was sent to or who replied (foreign key -> prescribers)

event_date.meaning: date the request was sent or the reply received

request_channel.meaning: channel the renewal request was sent through

source_request_id.meaning: the renewal request a denial answers; empty on requests

denial_reason.meaning: reason code the prescriber gave for declining

error_report_id.meaning: primary id of the dispensing-error report

prescription_id.meaning: prescription of the fill reported (foreign key -> rx_prescriptions)

fill_id.meaning: the single fill reported as dispensed in error (foreign key -> rx_fills)

reported_date.meaning: date the patient reported the error

review_outcome.meaning: pharmacist review outcome; only confirmed reports support a return or remake

reviewed_date.meaning: date the pharmacist recorded the outcome; empty while pending_review

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

coverage_id.meaning: primary id of the coverage record (one prescription insurance plan on the profile)

variant_name.meaning: plan class of the coverage, the official class name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the coverage record (see the Prescription Insurance on File charter)

payer_name.meaning: payer or plan name as printed on the member card

bin.meaning: BIN routing number from the member card

pcn.meaning: processor control number from the member card, exactly as printed

group_number.meaning: group number from the member card, exactly as printed

member_number.meaning: member ID printed on the member card, exactly as printed

person_code.meaning: person code identifying the patient under the cardholder

coverage_order.meaning: billing order of this plan among the patient's open coverage records

effective_date.meaning: first covered date of the plan; day 0 of the transition window

termination_date.meaning: last covered date reported by the payer; empty while no termination is reported

employer_claim_number.meaning: employer's injury claim number for workers' compensation, exactly as the patient states it; empty for other classes

opened_date.meaning: date the plan was added to the profile; day 0 of the eligibility verification window

closed_date.meaning: date the record was terminated or removed; empty while pending or active

claim_id.meaning: primary id of the claim-ledger row

event_type.meaning: claim-ledger event family, from the Prescription Insurance on File charter

event_date.meaning: date of service of a claim, or date of the reversal or notice

fill_number.meaning: fill number billed: 0 for the original fill, 1 upward for refills

claim_basis.meaning: basis on which the claim was submitted

submission_clarification_code.meaning: override code submitted with an early claim; none when no override

plan_paid_usd.meaning: amount the plan paid on a paid claim

patient_pay_usd.meaning: patient pay the plan assigned on a paid claim, or the patient pay booked back by a reversal; always positive

deductible_applied_usd.meaning: part of the patient pay applied to the plan deductible; 0.00 when none

pa_id.meaning: approved prior authorization a claim relies on (foreign key -> coverage_prior_auths); empty otherwise

reject_code.meaning: reject reason returned on a rejected claim

source_claim_id.meaning: the single paid claim a reversal or payment plan notice refers to

reversal_reason.meaning: why a paid claim was reversed

pa_id.meaning: primary id of the prior-authorization ledger row

coverage_id.meaning: coverage record the request is made to (foreign key -> coverage_plans)

event_type.meaning: prior-authorization event family, from the Prescription Insurance on File charter

event_date.meaning: date the request was submitted, decided, appealed or the appeal decided

source_pa_id.meaning: the single earlier row this row answers: the request decided, the denial appealed or the appeal decided; empty on a new request

review_type.meaning: review speed of a request or appeal

submission_channel.meaning: channel a request was submitted through

decision_due_date.meaning: date by which the plan must decide the request or appeal

approval_end_date.meaning: last date covered by an approval or overturned appeal; empty otherwise

denial_reason.meaning: reason the plan gave for a denial

enrollment_id.meaning: primary id of the savings or copay assistance enrollment

variant_name.meaning: program type, the official program name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the enrollment (see the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs charter)

program_name.meaning: program name as printed on the card or award letter, e.g. the manufacturer's savings program name

drug_name.meaning: drug the program is for; empty for Kestrel discount programs

bin.meaning: BIN routing number from the program card; empty where the program has none

pcn.meaning: PCN from the program card, exactly as printed

group_number.meaning: group number from the program card, exactly as printed

member_number.meaning: member ID from the program card or award letter, exactly as printed

enrollment_source.meaning: who enrolled the patient in the program

linked_coverage_id.meaning: coverage record the program pays after (foreign key -> coverage_plans); empty for cash-only programs

prescription_id.meaning: Kestrel prescription the program is tied to (foreign key -> rx_prescriptions); empty for Kestrel discount programs

household_member_count.meaning: people covered by the enrollment, the enrolling patient included

income_attested.meaning: whether the patient attested household income at enrollment

benefit_period_start.meaning: first day of the current benefit period or membership term

benefit_period_end.meaning: last day of the current benefit period or membership term

benefit_remaining_usd.meaning: program dollars left in the current benefit period; identically the sum of the benefit_budget account deltas

membership_fees_net_usd.meaning: membership fees paid less fees refunded; identically the sum of the membership_fees account deltas

suspended_date.meaning: date the enrollment was last suspended; day 0 of the resume window; empty unless suspended

expiration_date.meaning: last day the program can be used; empty where the program never expires

opened_date.meaning: date of enrollment; day 0 of the activation window

closed_date.meaning: date the enrollment expired or was cancelled; empty otherwise

activity_id.meaning: primary id of the program-activity ledger row

enrollment_id.meaning: enrollment the row belongs to (foreign key -> copay_enrollments)

event_type.meaning: program-activity event family, from the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs charter

fill_id.meaning: the single fill the benefit, discount or bridge supply applies to (foreign key -> rx_fills)

claim_id.meaning: insurance claim whose patient pay a benefit reduces (foreign key -> coverage_claims)

benefit_period_start.meaning: first day of the benefit period or membership term a period or fee row belongs to

usual_price_usd.meaning: usual and customary cash price of a discounted fill

patient_pay_before_usd.meaning: patient pay before the program was applied

patient_pay_after_usd.meaning: amount the patient paid after the program

amount_usd.meaning: amount of the row, always positive: dollars credited, applied, restored, lapsed, saved, charged or refunded; the event family gives the direction

refund_reason.meaning: why a membership fee was refunded

source_activity_id.meaning: the single earlier activity row a reversal or refund acts on

course_id.meaning: primary id of the vaccination course (one vaccine, and one season where seasonal)

variant_name.meaning: the vaccination, the official service name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the course (see the Immunization Services charter)

season_label.meaning: respiratory season the course belongs to, e.g. 2026-2027; empty for non-seasonal vaccines

doses_required.meaning: valid doses needed to complete this course for this patient

doses_remaining.meaning: valid doses still needed; identically the sum of the doses account deltas

immunocompromised.meaning: whether the patient attested being immunocompromised when the course was opened

risk_condition_attested.meaning: whether the patient attested a qualifying risk condition for the vaccine

billing_route.meaning: how the course's doses are paid: Medicare Part B, a pharmacy benefit, cash, or Vaccines for Children stock

coverage_id.meaning: coverage record billed (foreign key -> coverage_plans); empty for cash or Vaccines for Children

store_id.meaning: store where the course is given (foreign key -> stores)

closed_date.meaning: date the course completed or was cancelled; empty while scheduled or in progress

vax_event_id.meaning: primary id of the vaccination ledger row

course_id.meaning: course the row belongs to (foreign key -> vax_courses)

event_type.meaning: vaccination event family, from the Immunization Services charter

event_date.meaning: date the event happened (booking made, cancellation, missed appointment, consent signed, dose given, invalidation found, report sent)

appointment_time.meaning: start time of a booked appointment slot

store_id.meaning: store of the appointment or dose (foreign key -> stores)

dose_number.meaning: dose of the course the row concerns, 1 upward

is_final_dose.meaning: whether the dose completed (or, on an invalidation row, had completed) the course

auto_book_next.meaning: whether giving this dose automatically books the next dose

lot_number.meaning: manufacturer lot number of the dose given

coverage_id.meaning: coverage record billed for the dose (foreign key -> coverage_plans); empty for cash or Vaccines for Children

patient_pay_usd.meaning: amount the patient paid for the dose

observation_minutes.meaning: minutes the patient was observed after the dose

invalid_reason.meaning: why a dose does not count

source_event_id.meaning: the single earlier row this row acts on: the appointment cancelled, missed or kept, or the dose invalidated or reported

delivery_plan_id.meaning: primary id of the delivery plan

customer_id.meaning: patient the plan belongs to (foreign key -> customers)

variant_name.meaning: delivery plan held, the official plan name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the plan (see the Delivery & Pickup Services charter)

delivery_address.meaning: street line deliveries go to, exactly as the patient stated it

store_id.meaning: store that fulfils courier orders (foreign key -> stores)

trial_end_date.meaning: last day of the free trial: enrollment date plus trial_days

cycle_start_date.meaning: first day of the current billing cycle; empty for plans without a subscription

cycle_end_date.meaning: last day of the current billing cycle; empty for plans without a subscription

fees_net_usd.meaning: delivery fees paid less refunds; identically the sum of the delivery_fees account deltas

past_due_since.meaning: date the unpaid subscription charge failed; day 0 of the grace period; empty unless past due

cancellation_effective_date.meaning: date a patient's cancellation takes effect; empty unless cancelled by the patient

closed_date.meaning: date the plan ended; empty while enrolled, active or past due

order_id.meaning: primary id of the delivery-order ledger row

delivery_plan_id.meaning: plan the row belongs to (foreign key -> delivery_plans)

event_type.meaning: delivery-order event family, from the Delivery & Pickup Services charter

event_date.meaning: date the event happened (order placed, attempt, delivery, cancellation, return)

scheduled_date.meaning: date an order is to be delivered; day 0 of the lost-package windows

promised_window_end.meaning: end of the promised delivery window on the scheduled date

delivered_time.meaning: time an order was handed over or left

order_value_usd.meaning: value of the items in an order: patient pay of its prescriptions plus store items

includes_controlled.meaning: whether an order carries a controlled-substance prescription

includes_cold_chain.meaning: whether an order carries a temperature-controlled item

includes_front_store.meaning: whether an order carries non-prescription store items

distance_miles.meaning: road distance from the fulfilling store to the delivery address

source_order_id.meaning: the single order this row acts on; on a redelivery order, the failed order it replaces; empty on a first order

attempt_number.meaning: sequence of a failed attempt on its order, 1 upward

handover.meaning: how a delivered order was handed over

cancel_reason.meaning: why an order was cancelled before dispatch

store_id.meaning: store fulfilling or holding the order (foreign key -> stores)

charge_id.meaning: primary id of the delivery fee ledger row

delivery_plan_id.meaning: plan the fee belongs to (foreign key -> delivery_plans)

event_type.meaning: delivery fee event family, from the Delivery & Pickup Services charter

cycle_start_date.meaning: first day of the billing cycle a subscription fee pays for

source_order_id.meaning: order an order fee or its refund concerns (foreign key -> delivery_orders)

source_charge_id.meaning: the single fee a refund returns

amount_usd.meaning: amount charged or refunded, always positive; the event family gives the direction

refill_enrollment_id.meaning: primary id of the automated refill enrollment (one prescription in one program)

values: Kestrel Med Sync with Adherence Packaging
variant_name.meaning: refill program, the official program name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the enrollment (see the Auto Refill & Medication Sync charter)

sync_day.meaning: day of the month the patient's Med Sync cycles align to; empty for Auto Refill programs

next_cycle_date.meaning: date the next automated cycle is due

fulfillment_method.meaning: how automated cycles reach the patient

skips_remaining.meaning: skips left in the current program year; identically the sum of the skips account deltas

program_year_start.meaning: first day of the current program year: the enrollment date or its latest anniversary

pause_until_date.meaning: last day of the current pause; empty unless paused

unenroll_reason.meaning: why the enrollment was stopped or ended

closed_date.meaning: date the enrollment was stopped or ended; empty while open

cycle_id.meaning: primary id of the refill-cycle ledger row

refill_enrollment_id.meaning: enrollment the row belongs to (foreign key -> refill_enrollments)

event_type.meaning: refill-cycle event family, from the Auto Refill & Medication Sync charter

program_year_start.meaning: first day of the program year a skip allowance belongs to

skips_granted.meaning: skips credited by an allowance row

cycle_date.meaning: date a scheduled cycle is due

days_supply.meaning: days supply a cycle dispenses or dispensed

sync_short_fill.meaning: whether a cycle is a short fill bringing the prescription onto the sync day

source_cycle_id.meaning: the single scheduled cycle a confirmation, fill, skip or hold acts on

fill_id.meaning: fill a cycle produced (foreign key -> rx_fills)

hold_reason.meaning: why a cycle was held instead of filled

membership_id.meaning: primary id of the Kestrel Care Rewards membership

variant_name.meaning: membership level, the official level name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the membership (see the Kestrel Care Rewards charter)

member_number.meaning: rewards card number printed on the member's card

points_balance.meaning: unconverted points; identically the sum of the points account deltas

kestrel_cash_balance_usd.meaning: unused Kestrel Cash; identically the sum of the kestrel_cash account deltas

plus_fees_net_usd.meaning: Plus fees paid less refunds; identically the sum of the plus_fees account deltas

tier_year_start.meaning: first day of the tier year qualifying spend is measured in; empty for Plus

cycle_start_date.meaning: first day of the current Plus billing cycle; empty for free levels

suspended_date.meaning: date the membership was suspended; day 0 of the reinstatement window; empty unless suspended

closed_date.meaning: date the membership closed; empty while open

activity_id.meaning: primary id of the rewards ledger row

membership_id.meaning: membership the row belongs to (foreign key -> rewards_memberships)

event_type.meaning: rewards event family, from the Kestrel Care Rewards charter

source_ref_id.meaning: the single Kestrel record the row concerns: the purchase, fill, dose or failure record

purchase_amount_usd.meaning: eligible spend of a purchase that earned points; 0.00 otherwise

points.meaning: points moved by the row; the event family gives the direction

amount_usd.meaning: Kestrel Cash or fee amount moved by the row; the event family gives the direction

issue_reason.meaning: why a Kestrel Cash reward was issued

cash_expiration_date.meaning: last day an issued Kestrel Cash reward can be used

source_activity_id.meaning: the single earlier rewards row this row acts on (the entry reversed, the conversion or expired reward, the fee refunded)

billing_period_start.meaning: first day of the Plus billing cycle a fee pays for

store_id.meaning: store of the purchase, fill or dose (foreign key -> stores)

verification_id.meaning: primary id of the verification record (one per patient)

verified.meaning: whether identity verification passed; monotonically non-decreasing

verified_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
verified_at.meaning: moment of the most recent verification attempt

handoff_id.meaning: primary id of the human-handoff record

reason.meaning: reason for the handoff; closed set of exactly these two values

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
